scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c cyan,blue "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && node --test tests/search-suggestions.test.mjs tests/inactivity.test.mjs tests/faq.test.mjs tests/language-default.test.mjs tests/audit-labels.test.mjs tests/safety-admin.test.mjs tests/retired-features.test.mjs
scripts.security:check: npm audit --omit=dev && npm audit --omit=dev --prefix client && npm audit --omit=dev --prefix server
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:responsive
